nodes.label: Claude Code Delegation
nodes.rationale: Delegate genuinely big coding tasks (whole features, multi-file refactors, deep debugging, large reviews) to the claude CLI so the token-heavy work stays out of Vesta's own context; small edits are done directly because subprocess and autonomous-turn overhead exceeds Claude Code's value on modest work. Pass the user's exact intent, never a paraphrase.

nodes.label: Print Mode JSON Invocation
nodes.rationale: claude -p with --output-format json runs to completion in one call, returning only the final result blob; JSON mode is mandatory because session_id (for follow-ups) and result (to report back) are lost in plain-text mode. --permission-mode bypassPermissions is required or the CLI hangs forever prompting in non-interactive mode.

nodes.label: Session Resume and Fork
nodes.rationale: Sessions live on Claude Code's side; session_id is just a string held in conversation context and passed back via --resume, --continue, or --fork-session, so no Vesta storage is needed.

nodes.label: Worktree Isolation for Coding Tasks
nodes.rationale: Non-trivial coding work runs inside a git worktree on its own branch because the user always wants new work isolated; the worktree path and branch are reported back with the result.

nodes.label: Cost Caps (--max-turns / --max-budget-usd)
nodes.rationale: --max-turns is always set because a confused subagent can otherwise loop indefinitely at the caller's expense; --max-budget-usd adds a dollar cap.
